result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback by limiting any commitment to the current 12-month term, permitting reduction on 30 days’ notice, and replacing take-or-pay treatment with a non-penalty true-up. It changes only the commitment mechanics and preserves unrelated commercial terms. Drafting is professional, though “true-up of Fees for Services actually ordered” is slightly unclear because such fees would ordinarily already be payable and may not constitute a true-up of the commitment shortfall.
